title: Archt II-Solutions Archt (INTL)
description:
When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

 What you’ll be doing...
   

  

* Mid\-to\-Large Deal Ownership: Act as the primary technical lead for mid\-to\-large enterprise deals. Take full ownership of the technical sales cycle, from initial discovery and requirements gathering to the final solution presentation.
* Automation Scoping \& Strategy: Move beyond basic scripting to identify strategic automation opportunities. Assess customer environments and internal workflows to scope out where zero\-touch provisioning, API integrations, or RPA can be applied. Define these requirements clearly for the Automation Team or Architect I to execute.
* Technical Discovery \& Whiteboarding: Lead interactive customer workshops and whiteboard sessions with IT Directors and Network Managers. Uncover deep technical pain points and map them directly to our SD\-WAN, cloud, and modern telecom portfolio.
* Solution Architecture \& Validation: Design comprehensive, scalable network architectures. Oversee the generation of accurate Bill of Materials (BOMs) and technical RFP responses, ensuring everything is technically viable and aligned with delivery capabilities.
* Mentorship: Guide the Architect I in understanding the actual customer requirement and solution design
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Act as a bridge between Sales, Delivery, and Product. Ensure the solutions you architect are deployable by the delivery team and provide structured feedback to Product Management on mid\-market feature requests.


**What We’re Looking For...**
**You'll need to have:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related engineering field or four or more years of work experience.
* Four years of relevant work experience.
* Two or more years of experience in a customer\-facing pre\-sales, systems engineering, or solutions architecture role.
* Advanced Networking Knowledge: Deep understanding of enterprise architectures, including SD\-WAN, complex routing/switching (BGP, OSPF), firewalls, VPNs, and legacy telecom transitions.
* Automation Acumen: Strong ability to identify automation scope. You must understand how APIs work (REST/JSON) and how tools like Python, Terraform, or Ansible integrate into a network, even if you are no longer writing the code from scratch every day.
* Cloud Integration: Practical experience designing networks that connect securely to public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and understanding cloud\-native networking constructs.
* Presentation Skills: Proven ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value for mid\-level technical decision\-makers (Directors of IT, Network Managers).


**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**
* Mid\-level industry certifications such as Cisco CCNP (Enterprise or Security), AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, MEF SD\-WAN Professional, or equivalent.
* Experience navigating the transition of legacy MPLS networks to modern, internet\-first SD\-WAN or SASE architectures.
* Experience managing or orchestrating vendor relationships (OEMs) for specific components of a larger deal.


 If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
   

  

 Where you’ll be working
   

  

 In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
   

  

 Scheduled Weekly Hours
   

  

 40
   

  

 Equal Employment Opportunity
   

  

 Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: TPM/RGM Practice SME
description:
TPM \& RGM Practice SME
   

  

**About The Role**
 Cognizant’s Industry Solutions Group (ISG) is seeking a senior TPM \& RGM Practice SME for the Consumer Goods practice. This individual will serve as Cognizant’s primary domain authority for Trade Promotion Management and Revenue Growth Management — driving pre\-sales solutioning, building platform alliances, representing Cognizant at industry forums, and providing functional advisory support on client engagements.
   

  

 Primary platform focus: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM (first preference) and XTEL TPM/RGM (second preference).
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Domain \& Solutioning Leadership
   

  

* Serve as the TPM/RGM domain authority across Cognizant’s Consumer Goods practice — designing end\-to\-end solution architectures covering trade planning, fund management, promotion execution, deduction management, and RGM analytics.
* Lead client solution design workshops and discovery sessions, driving alignment between business objectives (volume, margin, trade ROI) and platform capabilities.


 Pre\-Sales \& Bid Support
   

  

* Lead RFP/RFI responses as the primary TPM/RGM domain voice — authoring solution narratives, effort models, and PoC demonstrations for Salesforce CG Cloud and XTEL engagements.
* Collaborate with Sales and Delivery teams on pursuit strategy and competitive positioning; build and maintain reusable solution accelerators, proposal templates, and reference architectures.


 Thought Leadership \& Practice Development
   

  

* Publish whitepapers, point\-of\-view papers, and industry blogs on TPM/RGM trends, platform innovations, and CPG commercial technology; represent Cognizant at conferences and speaking engagements.
* Build and contribute to Cognizant’s TPM/RGM CoE — defining best practices, developing delivery playbooks and reusable assets, and mentoring junior consultants within the Consumer Goods practice.


 Alliance \& Partnership Management
   

  

* Serve as Cognizant’s primary relationship manager with key TPM/RGM platform partners — Salesforce CG Cloud, XTEL, and relevant ISVs — nurturing joint GTM engagement, co\-sell pipeline, and aligned solution roadmaps.
* Track partner roadmaps and identify partnership opportunities with CPG ecosystem players (o9, Anaplan, BluePlanner) to extend Cognizant’s TPM/RGM service portfolio; develop joint collateral and partner sales plays.


 Industry Forum Participation \& External Engagement
   

  

* Represent Cognizant at CPG technology conferences and industry forums (Salesforce Consumer Goods Summit, CGT events, XTEL user groups); deliver presentations and panel discussions on trade transformation and AI\-driven RGM.
* Engage analyst communities (Gartner, Forrester, IDC) to position Cognizant’s capabilities; build an external professional network across CPG trade marketing and technology communities to generate leads and surface new service opportunities.


 Techno\-Functional Lead — Customer Project Support
   

  

* Serve as senior functional advisor on select engagements — providing domain expertise during blueprint, fit\-gap, and go\-live phases without owning day\-to\-day workstream delivery.
* Act as the functional escalation point for delivery teams — resolving complex design decisions and conducting periodic quality reviews of solution documents and test plans.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
 Domain \& Technical Skills
   

  

* Deep functional expertise in TPM (trade planning, fund management, promotion execution, settlement, deduction management, post\-event analytics) and RGM (pricing strategy, pack\-price architecture, mix management, net revenue optimization).
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM (primary) — account planning, fund configuration, promotion lifecycle, deduction management, and MuleSoft integration patterns.
* Hands\-on experience with XTEL TPM/RGM (second preference) — trade fund setup, promotion planning, claims processing, and SAP/Oracle ERP integration architecture.
* Experience on at least 2 full\-cycle TPM/RGM implementations; proficiency in delivery artifacts (BRDs, fit\-gap documents, configuration workbooks, UAT scripts) and platform partner/alliance engagement.


 Pre\-Sales \& Consulting Skills
   

  

* Excellent executive communication and presentation skills — able to influence VP/Director\-level stakeholders; proven track record contributing to and winning CPG/Consumer Goods RFPs.
* Strong analytical and problem\-structuring skills; ability to translate business challenges into platform solutions and produce high\-quality proposals, PoVs, and solution collateral.


**Experience Requirements**
 Dimension
   

  

 Requirement
   

  

 Total Experience
   

  

 12–15 years in IT Delivery, consulting or CPG domain
   

  

 TPM/RGM Domain
   

  

 6\+ years in Trade Promotion or Revenue Growth Management
   

  

 Techno\-Functional Lead
   

  

 4\+ years leading functional workstreams on TPM/RGM platform implementations
   

  

 Salesforce CG Cloud / XTEL
   

  

 3\+ years hands\-on on Salesforce CG Cloud TPM (preferred) or XTEL TPM/RGM; both is a strong advantage
   

  

 Pre\-Sales / Bid Work
   

  

 2\+ years contributing to RFP responses and client solutioning
   

  

 Client\-Facing Roles
   

  

 Experience managing stakeholder relationships at Director level

We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology\-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.

+ Sales forecasting

Join us and shape the future of sales and service!

* Practical knowledge of Agentic AI, generative AI, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool calling, or AI orchestration.

* Experience with Salesforce, Veeva CRM, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, SAP CPQ, or similar platforms.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, or healthcare commercial operations.
* Knowledge of HCP/HCO master data, customer consent, field force effectiveness, promotional compliance, and commercial data governance.
* Experience with cloud platforms, data warehouses, business intelligence tools, and low\-code/no\-code automation platforms.
* Familiarity with AI governance, model evaluation, prompt engineering, agent monitoring, and responsible AI practices.

**Education:**

description:
🇺🇸 US Market Development \& Field Sales Executive
 
**Chennai, India \+ USA \| 6 Months India / 6 Months USA** 




**We are looking for highly articulate, commercially driven and research\-oriented sales professionals** 
 to join our US healthcare business development team.
 



 This is a unique opportunity for professionals who want to build a long\-term career in
 **US B2B sales and business development** 
 .
 



 The role will be divided approximately equally between
 **India and the USA** 
 :
 



**6 months in India:** 
 Research, prospect identification, account intelligence, pre\-sales and pipeline development.
 



**6 months in the USA:** 
 In\-person meetings, relationship building, field sales, conferences and business development.
   




 🇮🇳 Your role in India – Pre\-Sales \& Pipeline Development
 
 You will be responsible for doing the detailed groundwork before an opportunity reaches the US sales team.
 



 You will:
 


* Research target US healthcare organizations
* Understand the company's business model, size, locations, services and estimated revenue
* Research the organization's current business challenges and potential areas of opportunity
* Identify the right decision\-makers and influencers
* Research executives and their backgrounds
* Identify verified contact information
* Build detailed account/prospect profiles
* Identify potential buying signals and business opportunities
* Conduct LinkedIn, email and telephone outreach
* Qualify prospects
* Develop relationships with prospects before the sales team engages
* Schedule qualified meetings
* Maintain detailed CRM information
* Prepare account intelligence and briefing notes for the US sales team
* Continuously build a qualified pipeline



**The objective is not simply to generate leads.** 




**The objective is to deliver well\-researched, qualified business opportunities** 
 to the US sales team.
   




 🇺🇸 Your role in the USA – Field Sales \& Business Development
 
 During your US assignment, you will transition into a client\-facing role.
 



 You will:
 


* Meet prospects and decision\-makers in person
* Visit healthcare organizations
* Conduct business development meetings
* Attend conferences and industry events
* Build executive relationships
* Follow up on opportunities developed during your India phase
* Identify new business opportunities
* Participate in discovery meetings
* Support presentations and proposals
* Work closely with the US sales leadership
* Develop opportunities through the sales cycle
* Represent Scintillate professionally in the US market


 🎯 Strict Qualification Criteria
 
**We are looking for a very specific profile. Please apply only if you meet most of the following requirements.** 



 Education
 * **Postgraduate degree is mandatory**
* **MBA / PGDM in Marketing, Sales, Business Development, International Business, Healthcare Management or a related discipline** 
 preferred
* Candidates with strong academic backgrounds and relevant postgraduate specialization will be preferred


 Experience
 * **3–7 years of relevant experience**
* **Prior experience in US\-focused pre\-sales, business development, inside sales, lead generation or market research is mandatory**
* **Experience selling into the US market is strongly preferred**
* **Experience dealing with US healthcare organizations, healthcare services, RCM, DMEPOS, medical billing, healthcare IT, BPO or SaaS** 
 will be a significant advantage
* Candidates must have experience independently researching US prospects and identifying decision\-makers
* Experience using
 **LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Crunchbase or similar sales intelligence/prospecting platforms** 
 preferred
* Hands\-on experience working with a CRM such as
 **HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Nutshell or similar**


 🗣️ Communication — Critical Requirement
 
**Excellent English communication skills are mandatory.** 




**The candidate must be:** 



* Extremely articulate and confident in spoken English
* Comfortable speaking with
 **US C\-level executives, VPs, Directors and business owners**
* **Able to conduct a professional discovery conversation**
* **Able to ask intelligent business questions**
* **Able to understand and respond to different US accents**
* **Able to communicate clearly without excessive reliance on scripts**
* **Strong in business writing, including emails and LinkedIn communication**
* **Comfortable presenting information to senior executives**
* **Able to communicate professionally in person as well as virtually**



**Candidates with weak spoken English or limited experience communicating with US business executives will not be considered.**



 🔎 Research \& Analytical Skills
 
 This is equally important.
 



 The candidate should be able to take a company name and independently answer:
 



**Who are they?** 




**What do they do?** 




**How large are they?** 




**What is their approximate revenue?** 




**Where do they operate?** 




**Who makes the decision?** 




**What problems might they have?** 




**Why would they potentially need our services?** 




**Who else should we speak with?** 




**You should enjoy researching companies and people** 
 , not just making calls.
   




 ✈️ Mobility \& Travel
 * Must be willing and able to spend approximately
 **6 months each year in the USA**
* **Must be comfortable with frequent domestic travel within the US**
* **Must be comfortable conducting face\-to\-face meetings with senior executives**
* **Must be willing to attend conferences, trade shows and networking events**
* **Appropriate US travel/work authorization will be required for the activities undertaken during the US assignment**


 ⭐ The person we are looking for
 
 We are
 **not looking for a conventional telesales executive.** 




**We are looking for someone who combines:** 




**Researcher \+ Pre\-Sales Professional \+ Business Development Executive \+ Relationship Builder \+ Field Salesperson** 




**Someone who can spend Monday morning researching a 500\-employee healthcare company, understand its business, identify its CFO/COO/VP Revenue Cycle, build an intelligent outreach strategy — and six months later sit across the table from that executive in the United States and have a meaningful business conversation.** 




  





**If you are highly articulate, commercially curious, comfortable with senior executives and genuinely interested in the US market** 
 , this could be an excellent opportunity to build a long\-term international sales career.
 



 📍
 **Base:** 
 Chennai, India
 



 🇺🇸
 **US Assignment:** 
 Approximately 6 months annually
 



 💼
 **Experience:** 
 3–7 years
 



 🎓
 **Postgraduate qualification:** 
 Mandatory
 



 🇺🇸
 **US pre\-sales/business development experience:** 
 Mandatory
 



 🏥
 **US Healthcare experience:** 
 Strongly preferred

title: Cost & Quotation Specialist
description:
**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a Supplier Cost \& Quotation Specialist within SCM to support Sales and project teams with daily quotation activities, cost validation, and early\-stage sourcing strategy alignment with suppliers.
   

  

 This role plays a critical part in pre\-sales engagement ensuring cost accuracy, data integrity, and supplier strategy alignment during the quotation phase. The position plays a critical role in connecting Sales, Engineering, Category Management, and Supply Chain, enabling competitive, realistic, and executable offers.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Support sales quotations by validating supplier costs, material master data, and market benchmarks to ensure competitive and accurate pricing.
* Review and challenge cost assumptions, identify risks/gaps, and ensure alignment between quoted, system, and execution costs.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Sales, Category Managers, and Supply Chain to clarify technical requirements and sourcing strategies.
* Manage cost data governance by ensuring Material Master accuracy, completeness, and alignment with current supplier pricing and lead times.
* Drive early sourcing engagement with Category Managers to leverage agreements, mitigate risks, and identify cost\-saving opportunities.
* Act as the key interface between Sales, Engineering, Category Management, and Supply Chain throughout the quotation process.
* Provide market intelligence on pricing trends, supplier capabilities, risks, and key cost drivers within the energy industry.
* Monitor quotation performance through dashboards, pipeline tracking, win/loss analysis, RFQ cycle times, and supplier responsiveness.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quotation accuracy, process efficiency, cost transparency, and digitalization.
* Track and improve key KPIs, including cost accuracy, cost savings, quotation quality, on\-time submissions, data accuracy, win rates, margin performance, and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (preferred), Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in project procurement, quotation/bid support, cost analysis, supply chain, or commercial functions.
* Strong knowledge of the energy industry, including high\-voltage equipment, transformers, and electrical components/systems.
* Expertise in cost structures and technical\-commercial evaluation, with the ability to assess quotation feasibility and profitability.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP (Material Master, Costing) or similar ERP systems for cost validation and data management.
* Advanced analytical and reporting skills, particularly in Excel, Power BI, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Strong commercial acumen, attention to detail, and ability to challenge data, assumptions, and cost discrepancies.
* Proven ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders, act as a trusted advisor to Sales, and bridge technical, commercial, and operational perspectives.

title: Senior Technical Consultant
description:
**About Workhall** 




 Workhall is a bootstrapped low\-code / no\-code enterprise workflow platform. We help large organisations model complex operations as configurable data structures, workflows, and reports, without the cost and drag of bespoke custom development. Today we serve 20\+ enterprise customers across India, Australia, and the Americas, in industries ranging from manufacturing, food and beverage, construction, trade, and private capital.
 



**About the role** 




 You will be the technical backbone that turns the Workhall platform into a working enterprise application. Sitting inside the professional services team, you own requirements gathering, solution design, solve the hard data\-modelling and integration problems that complex customers bring, and act as the deep technical reference point for our implementation partners.
 



 This is a senior, hands\-on solutioning role for someone who is equally comfortable whiteboarding an architecture and configuring the platform themselves. You are not just advising from the sidelines. You design, you build, and you set the standard others follow.
 



**What you will do** 





 Solution design and architecture
 



* Own end\-to\-end solution design on the platform: datalists, workflows, roles and permissions, reports, and the expression logic that ties them together.
* Translate ambiguous enterprise requirements into robust, scalable, maintainable configurations rather than one\-off hacks.
* Make and defend data\-modelling decisions, including denormalization and relationship patterns, with an eye on performance and long\-term maintainability on a document\-database platform.




 Build and delivery
 



* Configure and build complex applications.
* Design and implement integrations between Workhall and external enterprise systems.
* Own the hardest technical parts of an implementation, and unblock delivery teams when they hit the limits of the platform or the data model.




 Customer and stakeholder engagement
 



* Run technical discovery workshops with enterprise customers, shape the application, and communicate trade\-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor through an implementation, from design through go\-live and stabilisation.




 Partner enablement and quality
 



* Enable, review, and raise the quality bar for implementation partners so delivery stays consistent as we scale.
* Define reusable patterns, templates, and technical standards that the wider delivery ecosystem can adopt.




 What we are looking for
 



* Experience. 3 to 6 years in enterprise software implementation, solution consulting, or technical delivery, including meaningful time on low\-code / no\-code, BPM, or workflow automation platforms.
* Data modelling. Strong data\-modelling instincts and comfort with document or NoSQL databases; MongoDB experience is a clear advantage.
* Platform depth. Ability to reason about workflow logic, conditional expressions, and integrations from first principles, not just by copying prior examples.
* Communication. Customer\-facing maturity: you can run a workshop, defend a design decision, manage expectations, and say no well.
* Ownership. A track record of owning the technically hardest part of a project and getting it live.




 Nice to have
 



* Familiarity with LCNC platform, API design, scripting, or integration middleware.




 Why join us
 



* Ownership. Real ownership. We are a lean, bootstrapped team, so your work ships and your judgement counts from week one.
* Depth. Hard, interesting problems. Modelling messy enterprise operations into clean, reusable software is genuinely difficult and genuinely rewarding.
* Range. Breadth of exposure. You will work across regulated industries and global markets, not a single narrow use case.
* Leverage. A platform with leverage. What you build once serves many customers and many verticals.

 About the Role

 **Brand Partnerships \& Alliances professional** 
 to support the development and management of a growing brand partnership ecosystem.
 



 The role will primarily focus on building a strong pipeline of prospective brand partners through structured market research, brand identification, decision\-maker mapping and outreach, while also managing the coordination, performance tracking and commercial follow\-up of existing partnerships.
 



 The candidate should be capable of independently identifying relevant brands and the right stakeholders, establishing initial contact and generating qualified meetings.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. Brand Research \& Partnership Pipeline** 



* Research and identify potential brand partners across consumer\-facing categories such as Jewellery, Apparel, Consumer Electronics, Appliances, Travel, Beauty \& Grooming, Furniture, Lifestyle and other relevant sectors.
* Build and maintain category\-wise, city\-wise and state\-wise databases of prospective brands.

* Identify relevant decision\-makers across Partnerships, Alliances, Marketing, Business Development and senior management.



**2\. Brand Outreach \& Meeting Generation**

* Generate and schedule qualified meetings with decision\-makers.
* Undertake structured follow\-ups to move conversations forward.
* Maintain an active and measurable partnership pipeline.



**3\. Existing Brand \& Partner Management** 



* Coordinate periodic performance and relationship reviews with active brand partners.
* Track partnership performance, customer engagement and other agreed business metrics.
* Coordinate collection and consolidation of relevant partner data.
* Maintain action items from partner reviews and follow through until closure.
* Identify recurring issues or dependencies and escalate them appropriately.



**4\. Commercial \& Payment Coordination** 



* Coordinate with internal teams for partner\-related delivery and performance data.
* Support timely raising and submission of applicable invoices.
* Maintain brand\-wise trackers covering invoices, due dates, payments and outstanding amounts.
* Follow up with partners and internal Finance teams for reconciliation and closure.



**5\. Cross\-functional Coordination** 



* Work closely with Finance, Operations, Product, Marketing and other internal stakeholders.
* Ensure brand information, commercials, offers, locations and operational requirements are accurately maintained.
* Coordinate resolution of operational and partner\-related issues.
* Maintain organised records and documentation across partnerships.



**6\. MIS \& Reporting** 



* Maintain a comprehensive partnership dashboard covering the funnel from
 **Target Brand → Decision\-Maker → Outreach → Meeting → Partnership Status → Performance → Invoicing → Collections** 
 .
* Provide weekly updates on prospects, outreach, meetings and pending follow\-ups.
* Prepare periodic performance summaries for active partnerships.
* Maintain clear visibility on ownership, timelines and pending actions.


 Candidate Profile

 **5 years of relevant professional experience** 
 , preferably in Brand Partnerships, Brand Alliances, Strategic Alliances, Partnerships, Key Account Management or related functions.
* Strong experience in independently researching brands and identifying relevant decision\-makers.
* Hands\-on experience using
 **LinkedIn and professional networks for corporate prospecting and stakeholder mapping** 
 .

* Experience managing multiple external partners and coordinating with internal teams.
* Experience in
 **Retail, Jewellery, Apparel, Consumer Electronics, FMCG, E\-commerce, Travel, Lifestyle, Loyalty/Rewards or Gifting**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, Management or a related discipline;
 **MBA/PGDM preferred but not mandatory**

 Strong market research and prospecting skills, excellent communication and networking ability, relationship management, commercial understanding, structured follow\-up, stakeholder management, strong execution and closure orientation, and proficiency in
 **Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint and CRM/MIS tools** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should be

title: AI Native Product Marketer
description:
**AI\-Native GTM / Product Marketing Operator**




  





**About Facilio**




  





 Facilio is the agentic platform transforming how large buildings manage their physical operations. We are the AI\-native operating layer for buildings on a mission to make buildings operationally efficient.
 



  





 Today, 150\+ enterprise customers across hospitals, universities, retail chains, landmark venues and large real estate portfolios use Facilio to drive cost efficiency, service quality, compliance and operational performance.
 



  





 With a growing presence across the US, UK, Middle East and Australia, Facilio is backed by leading global investors including Accel, Tiger Global, Dragoneer and Brookfield Growth.
 



 We aim to bring agentic AI to the physical world — moving enterprise operations from systems that record and manage work to intelligent systems that understand, decide and act.
 



  





**Build the next generation of GTM at Facilio.**




  





 At Facilio, we're building an AI\-first enterprise SaaS platform for teams that run physical operations. As AI changes how products are built, sold and marketed, we’re rethinking what a modern marketing team should look like too.
 



  





 We're looking for someone early in their career who understands
 **Product Marketing** 
 but thinks beyond traditional marketing execution.
 



  





 The old model:
 



**Marketer → thinks of an idea → uses AI → creates the asset → distributes it** 




  





 The model we're building:
 



**Understand the GTM objective → identify what needs to happen → orchestrate AI agents \+ existing systems → review \& steer the output → learn from the result → improve the system.** 




  





 This role builds and owns that shift for the PMM function. Think of it as a GTM engineer's systems fluency, aimed specifically at product marketing judgment.
 



  





**What you'll do**




  




* Understand our
 **products, customers, ICPs and GTM motions** 
 deeply enough to identify what marketing should actually do — not just execute briefs.
* Take existing PMM workflows (case studies, social posts, enablement docs, battlecards, email sequences) and rebuild them as connected mini\-agents — triggered by real events in our systems, not by someone opening a chat and typing a brief
* Define what each agent should draft autonomously vs. where it must stop and hand off to a human — this is a marketing judgment call, not just a technical guardrail
* Use AI not just to create content, but to
 **identify opportunities, generate ideas, make recommendations and trigger the next action** 
 .
* Review and QA agent output against real marketing standards: does this case study lead with the right proof point for this funnel stage? Does this battlecard actually counter the objection or just restate our positioning?
* Build systems that can take something like a product update or customer signal and determine what messaging, content, enablement or GTM action should follow.
* Bring strong judgement to the output:
 **what is worth saying, who should hear it, when, through which channel, and why.**
* Continuously measure what works and improve the underlying workflow, agent or system — not just the individual output.



  





**What you'll need to bring**




  





**1\. PMM fundamentals** 




 You understand positioning, messaging, ICPs, personas, buyer journeys, content, launches, customer stories and sales enablement — and know what good looks like.
 



**2\. GTM judgement** 




 You can look at a product, customer or market signal and figure out
 **what should happen next** 
 . You understand that the same story, proof point or message won't work equally well across every persona or funnel stage.
 



**3\. AI / agent orchestration** 




 You don't just ask Claude or ChatGPT to write faster. You instinctively ask:
 **Can this workflow be automated? Can an agent do this? What context should it have? What systems should it connect to? Where should a human stay in the loop?** 




**4\. Systems thinking** 




 You enjoy breaking messy, repetitive workflows into inputs, decisions, actions and feedback loops — and turning them into scalable systems.
 



**5\. Execution ownership** 




 You're still a doer. You can take an idea from
 **problem → system → output → measurement** 
 , rather than waiting for someone else to define the work for you.
 



  





**Who this is for**




  




* **1–3 years of experience** 
 in Product Marketing, B2B SaaS marketing, GTM, growth or a closely related role.
* Someone who is
 **curious about how things work and obsessed with making them better** 
 .
* Someone who experiments with AI tools and wants to go beyond prompting into
 **building workflows, agents and systems** 
 .
* Someone who can move between
 **customer thinking, product understanding, marketing judgement and technology** 
 .
* Someone who would rather build a system that eliminates 10 hours of recurring work than become really good at doing those 10 hours.



  





**What this role is NOT**




  




* Not a content writer who occasionally uses AI tools
* Not a pure automation/RevOps builder with no marketing instinct
* Not someone who needs an idea handed to them before they can execute — the whole point is they (and their agents) originate ideas

**ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Premium School Acquisition (Primary — 60% of effort): Identify, prospect, and close new contracts with premium schools (annual fee ≥ ₹25,000\); target 6\-7 new school sign\-ups per quarter through consultative, outcome\-led conversations with principals, trustees, and academic heads.
* Distributor Channel Alignment (Secondary — 25% of effort): Onboard, and grow distributor partners across the territory; ensure ≥ 70% of registered distributors generate at least one order per quarter; drive ≥ 25% YoY distributor revenue growth.
* Pipeline Generation \& Lead Management: Maintain a live pipeline of ≥ 2\.5× monthly quota; generate 30–50 qualified leads per month from channel partners, referrals, and direct outreach; log all activities in CRM within 24 hours.
* Consultative Needs Diagnosis: Run structured discovery meetings to uncover each school's English\-learning gaps, outcome objectives, and budget cycle; tailor Fluento's value proposition to each institution's specific context.
* Relationship \& Retention Management: Ensure Year\-1 schools transition into Year\-2 renewals at ≥ 85% rate through proactive engagement, usage reviews, and outcome showcasing.
* Market Intelligence \& Reporting: Provide weekly pipeline and territory health reports; flag competitive activity and pricing pressure; share school\-level feedback to inform product and pricing strategy.



  





**Location \& Travel** 



* Base location: Designated city in assigned multi\-city territory
* Travel: 80% field travel (4–5 days per week); inter\-city travel as required for distributor and school coverage
* Coverage: 3–6 cities per territory depending on density and market maturity



  





**EXPERIENCE**




**Educational \& Professional Experience:** 



* Minimum experience: 3–6 years in B2B field sales with a quota\-carrying role
* Education: Bachelor's degree (any discipline); MBA preferred but not mandatory
* Language: Fluency in English \+ local language(s) of assigned territory (mandatory for school conversations)
* Technical: Proficiency in CRM tools (Salesforce, Zoho, or HubSpot); working knowledge of MS Excel for pipeline tracking; ability to build and deliver slide\-based presentations (PowerPoint / Google Slides)



**Must Have Criteries:** 



* Consultative Selling Experience: Demonstrated track record of running needs\-diagnosis\-led sales conversations (not feature\-pitch selling); ability to coach a school principal through problem articulation and ROI framing.
* Established Relationships with Premium Schools: Active, referenceable relationships with school decision\-makers (principals, trustees, management committees) at institutions with annual programme fees of ₹25,000 or above.
* Distributor\-Routed Business Experience: Proven experience building and managing distributor or channel partner networks; must be able to describe distributor onboarding, activation, and revenue management processes from personal experience.
* B2B Field Sales Experience: Minimum 3 years of end\-to\-end B2B field sales experience, preferably in EdTech, publishing, curriculum, or related education\-adjacent sectors; track record of independently closing mid\-size contracts.



  





**COMPETENCIES REQUIRED** 




**Desired Skills:** 



* Experience selling English\-language, literacy, or supplementary curriculum products to K–12 institutions
* Knowledge of CBSE / ICSE / State Board school procurement and approval processes
* Prior experience managing a multi\-city territory independently (without daily managerial oversight)
* Experience with schools transitioning from traditional text\-book models to tech\-integrated curriculum



**Personality \& Behavioural Competencies** 



* Hunter mindset with patience: Comfortable with long consultative cycles (30–45 days) while maintaining full pipeline discipline
* Challenger communicator: Able to reframe school concerns, handle objections without discounting, and anchor conversations on outcomes
* Organised self\-starter: Plans weekly school visit schedules independently; prioritises high\-potential accounts without prompting
* Relationship equity builder: Earns genuine trust from school stakeholders — not just transactional rapport
* Data\-driven reporter: Updates CRM daily; pulls pipeline data to self\-manage against quota



**Leadership Competencies** 



* Ability to coach and support distributor partners through sales conversations
* Capacity to mentor junior sales staff once team expands
* Strategic thinking on territory market mapping, prioritises effort by revenue potential

title: Advisory Account Manager
description:
**Company Description**
 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role**
 The Advisory Account Manager (AAM) is a dual\-mandate, portfolio\-owning role. Unlike a traditional CSM or a pure hunter\-AM, the AAM operates as a trusted advisor across the full customer lifecycle — responsible simultaneously for protecting Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and driving Net Expansion through upsell and cross\-sell. This is a digital\-first, high\-velocity motion that blends proactive advisory engagement with a disciplined, data\-driven approach to identifying both risk and opportunity across the assigned book.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own an assigned portfolio of accounts end\-to\-end, accountable for both renewal/retention (GRR) and expansion outcomes across the book.
* Proactively engage customers using the tiered digital engagement model (tech\-touch, low\-touch, and 1:many plays based on segment and risk/opportunity signal).
* Build and execute account\-level Customer Success Plans that identify whitespace for upsell/cross\-sell and flag early indicators of churn or contraction risk.
* Run consultative value conversations with key stakeholders — demonstrating ROI, product adoption gains, and business outcomes tied to the Freshworks suite.
* Drive expansion revenue through upsell (higher tiers, additional seats) and cross\-sell (adjacent Freshworks products) to meet or exceed a blended revenue target.
* Identify at\-risk accounts early using health scores, usage data, and engagement signals; build and execute save plans in partnership with Support, Billing, and Deal Desk.
* Maintain deep product fluency across the Freshworks suite to run demos, map use cases, and recommend the best\-fit solution for a customer's problem.
* Use the customer success platform to track account health, adoption metrics, and pipeline, and to report portfolio status on a defined cadence.
* Partner cross\-functionally with RevOps, Renewals, Sales, Support, and Product Marketing to remove friction across the customer journey.
* Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene for both the expansion and renewal book.
* Adhere to Freshworks compliance and information security processes in all customer\-facing activity.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Consistent attainment against a blended quota comprising Net Expansion (upsell/cross\-sell bookings) and Gross Revenue Retention (renewal/anti\-churn).
* Improving product adoption and account health scores across the assigned portfolio.
* A portfolio where expansion is proactively sourced — not just reactive to inbound demand — while renewal risk is caught and mitigated well ahead of the renewal date.


**Qualifications**
* 3–7 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or SaaS sales, with direct experience carrying both a retention and an expansion/upsell number.
* Demonstrated track record of account growth (upsell/cross\-sell) alongside strong renewal/retention performance — not one at the expense of the other.
* Consultative approach: comfortable building business cases, ROI narratives, and stakeholder\-mapped account plans.
* Experience managing a digital\-first portfolio at scale, using tech\-touch and low\-touch cadences alongside targeted 1:1 engagement.
* Working knowledge of SaaS retention/expansion metrics — GRR, NRR, churn, expansion ARR, adoption.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate technical/product concepts for varying stakeholder levels (ESSENTIAL).
* Comfort working with CRM and customer success tooling for health scoring, forecasting, and reporting.
* Self\-starter, organized, and able to prioritize across a large book without losing attention to at\-risk or high\-potential accounts.


 Bachelor's degree required; Business or Computer Science background preferred
   

  

**Additional Information**
 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: Provider Management Specialist
description:
**About Amplify Health**




**Who We Are** 




 Amplify Health is Asia’s leading health technology and analytics organisation, providing our customers with integrated solutions to make healthcare more accessible, affordable and effective across the region.
 



  





 We offer a unique B2B business model and integrated stack of SaaS\-based products, PaaS\-based HealthTech launchpad and DaaS\-based on\-demand data offerings to deliver impact to our customers across the healthcare value\-chain.
 



  





 Our joint\-venture partners, AIA and Discovery, have provided us with the foundations and a platform that truly differentiates us from our competitors and allows us to build and deploy products at a scale and quality that few can match.
 



  





 We aim to be the trusted custodian of Asia's largest repository of health data, unifying financial, clinical, operational and behavioural data to empower our customers with insights that highlight opportunities to deliver better value and care outcomes.
 



  





**Our Vision and Ambition** 




 To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.
 



 Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value\-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.
 



 By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health\-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.
 



  





**The Position**




**Summary** 




 As a Provider Management Specialist, the role is a specialist advisor position supporting private health insurers to improve their claims risk management, primarily through provider contracting strategy, panel optimisation, patient pathway design, and insurance product alignment.
 



 You will work directly with client teams, enabling them to build stronger provider networks, negotiate effectively, utilise data insights, and apply best‑practice provider management strategies within the healthcare and HealthTech ecosystem.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\) On‑Site Client Advisory \& Provider Management Support** 



* Serves as the primary advisor to senior insurer stakeholders to drive and support provider management targets, initiatives and implementations, including, supporting strategic initiatives, contracting cycles, and provider engagement plans.
* Shapes multi‑year provider strategy, including contracting redesign and ecosystem partnerships.
* Develop high‑quality materials for client prep sessions, executive updates, and provider negotiations, ensuring clarity, coherence and insight‑driven storytelling.
* Serve as an embedded advisor supporting the client’s operational and strategic objectives.



**2\) Internal Provider Analytics Product Development** 



* Translate key client needs, pain points, and market insights into product requirements.
* Provide structured feedback to evolve Amplify Health’s provider analytics tools, dashboards and negotiation support solutions.
* Acts as the thought partner to product leadership for long‑term roadmap development.



**3\) Capability Building and Upskilling Client Teams** 



* Identify and prioritize key knowledge gaps and design tailored workshops, demos and training modules to upskill capabilities across client teams.
* Run coaching and role‑play sessions to elevate client teams’ provider negotiation capabilities and commercial acumen to improve negotiations for provider engagements.



  





**Candidate Profile**




**Experience and Qualifications** 



* Over 6 years experience in health insurance, health\-related industries or consulting.
* Demonstrated success in managing cost efficiencies in healthcare, whether at providers, insurers or population health level.
* Proven experience in client advisory work particularly in healthcare related work.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA or relevant) strongly preferred.



  





**Competencies \& Core Characteristics:** 




 We are seeking a leader who embodies the following competencies and characteristics essential for success in our scale\-up environment:
 


* **Strategic Architect:** 
 Able to connect disparate information into a cohesive strategy leveraging Amplify Health frameworks. Capable of designing clear, actionable paths for clients navigating complex provider ecosystems.
* **Data\-Driven Decisiveness:** 
 Confidence in working with data, identifying insights, and translating analytics into compelling narratives. Ensures objective, evidence‑based decision‑making in provider negotiations and strategy formulation.
* **Customer‑Obsessed Advocate:** 
 Anticipates client needs and proactively delivers value through insights, structure and advisory support.
* **Resilient Operator:** 
 able to operate in a fluid and changing start\-up environment, flexing between internal work and client facing modes
* **Unifier \& Cross\-Functional Influencer:** 
 Collaborates seamlessly across clinical, analytics, commercial and product teams. Drives alignment and shared understanding between stakeholders.

title: Manager Revenue Operations
description:
**Who are we?** 




 Securin is an AI\-driven cybersecurity company focused on proactive, adversarial exposure and vulnerability management. Our mission is to help organizations reduce cyber risk by identifying, prioritising, and remediating the issues that matter most. Powered by a seasoned team of threat researchers and status as a Certified Naming Authority (CNA), Securin combines artificial intelligence / machine learning, threat intelligence, and deep vulnerability research (including the Dark Web) to deliver an adversarial approach to cyber defence. We help enterprises shift from reactive patching to strategic, risk\-based exposure and vulnerability management – driving smarter security decisions and faster remediation.
 



  





**What do we promise?** 




 We are a highly effective tech\-enabled cybersecurity solutions provider and promise continual security posture improvement, enhanced attack surface visibility, and proactive prioritized remediation for every one of our client businesses.
 



  





**What do we provide?** 



* A chance to be on the leading edge of cybersecurity and AI
* Ability to have direct impact on company growth and revenue strategy
* An opportunity to mentor and be mentored by experts in multiple disciplines



  





**What do we deliver?** 




 Securin helps organizations to identify and remediate the most dangerous exposures, vulnerabilities, and risks in their environment. We deliver predictive and definitive intelligence and facilitate proactive remediation to help organizations stay a step ahead of attackers.
 



  





 By utilizing our cybersecurity solutions, our clients can have a proactive and holistic view of their security posture and protect their assets from even the most advanced and dynamic attacks.
 



 Securin has been recognized by national and international organizations for its role in accelerating innovation in offensive and proactive security. Our combination of domain expertise, cutting\-edge technology, and advanced tech\-enabled cybersecurity solutions has made Securin a leader in the industry.
 



  





**Job Location :** 
 Chennai (Hybrid Model : 2\-3 days a week to office)
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This is a hands\-on IC role: you'll own CRM hygiene, reporting, forecasting, and process enforcement. The core GTM systems and processes are already in place. Your role is to drive adoption, improve execution, and identify where those systems need refinement — not undertake a wholesale rebuild.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Drive adoption of existing CRM and revenue processes across sales, marketing, and CS — find where reps skip steps, and fix it
* Drive team\-wide MEDDIC adoption; coach reps; report on qualification data quality
* Own revenue reporting — Pipeline visibility, funnel conversion by stage, forecast accuracy
* Own forecasting cadence and accuracy in partnership with sales leadership
* Continuously refine the sales process using data — stall points, broken handoffs, adoption gaps
* Align sales, marketing, and CS on shared process and data usage
* Maintain CRM data quality — clear ownership of required fields, stage progression, activity capture, and opportunity hygiene
* Own CRM/system change requests, incorporating input from sales leadership and consultants, and drive them through to adoption
* Use GenAI tools to accelerate reporting, analysis, and documentation — validate outputs before they inform decisions



  





**Requirements:** 



* 5\+ years of relevant experience in B2B SaaS set up \- in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Operations, CRM Operations, or a related revenue\-facing operations role, in B2B SaaS
* Hands\-on, independent fluency with HubSpot (or equivalent CRM), Clay, and Apollo — able to operate and troubleshoot these from day one
* Track record building and defending pipeline forecasts and revenue dashboards
* Proven ability to drive process adoption in a sales org — not just design it
* Strong cross\-functional influence — comfortable changing team behavior without formal authority



  





**Core AI Skill Requirements:** 




 Securin is committed to becoming an AI\-native organization where GenAI is embedded into how every team works \- not just as an occasional assistant, but as a core part of delivery, operations, and how our expertise compounds over time. We expect every employee to actively integrate GenAI tools into daily workflows \- automating routine tasks, accelerating research and analysis, drafting documents, and building reusable AI\-powered processes for their function. You should understand the limitations of GenAI (including inaccuracies and data sensitivity boundaries), follow data classification rules, and continuously improve your AI proficiency. As you grow, we expect you to move beyond using GenAI to building with it \- designing agent workflows, contributing reusable skills, and helping Securin compound its Proactive Exposure Management expertise faster than any competitor can replicate.
 



  




* Demonstrated ability to use GenAI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) for daily work \- drafting, research, summarization, data analysis, code generation, or workflow automation as relevant to the Pro.
* Working knowledge of GenAI limitations including hallucination risk, context window constraints, and data sensitivity boundaries; ability to validate AI\-generated output before acting on it
* Familiarity with prompt engineering techniques \- structuring multi\-step instructions, providing context, and iterating on output quality to achieve production\-grade results
* Comfort with agentic AI workflows \- using, designing, or building multi\-step AI agents that execute tasks autonomously with human\-in\-the\-loop validation
* Awareness of AI security fundamentals \- prompt injection risks, data classification rules, sandboxed execution, and responsible handling of sensitive data in AI workflows
* Familiarity with connecting GenAI tools to internal data sources, APIs, and enterprise systems
* Ability to contribute reusable AI skills, templates, agent configurations, or automation workflows to a shared repository for team\-wide use
* Willingness to learn and adopt new AI tools as they evolve; participation in AI adoption sprints, hackathons, and knowledge\-sharing within the team



  





 If you meet the above requirements and are passionate about cybersecurity and providing excellent customer service, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
 



  





**Why should we connect?** 




 We are a bunch of passionate cybersecurity professionals who are building a culture of security. Today, cybersecurity is no more a luxury but a necessity with a global market value of $150 billion.
 



  





 At Securin, we live by a people\-first approach. We firmly believe that our employees should enjoy what they do. For our employees, we provide a hybrid work environment with competitive best\-in\-industry pay, while providing them with an environment to learn, thrive, and grow. Our hybrid working environment allows employees to work from the comfort of their homes or the office if they choose to. For the right candidate, this will feel like your second home.
 



  





 If you are passionate about cybersecurity just as we are, we would love to connect and share ideas.

Your ultimate goal is to create an unbeatable competitive advantage by continuously improving our efficiency, quality, and delivery, directly reducing our clients' Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Client Solution Engineering \& Integration (External Focus)**
* Lead Technical Discovery \& Solution Design: Post\-sale, partner with the Solutioning team to lead deep\-dive technical workshops with clients. Deconstruct their current workflows, data challenges, and business objectives.
* Architect Custom Integration Plans: Design and map out how our platform and services will integrate seamlessly into the client's existing AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure.
* Act as the "Art of the Possible" Guide: Serve as the primary technical advisor to clients, demonstrating how our advanced capabilities, custom tools, and innovative workflows can solve their most difficult data challenges and accelerate their AI initiatives.
* Bridge to the Platform Team: Translate complex client requirements into precise technical specifications and user stories for our core Platform Deployment \& Management team, ensuring our platform roadmap is directly informed by real\-world client needs.
* Oversee Proofs of Concept (POCs): Lead and develop targeted POCs to prove the value and viability of our solutions within the client's environment, de\-risking large\-scale engagements.


**Internal Process Transformation \& Innovation (Internal Focus)**
* Drive Process Excellence: Be the owner of operational efficiency for our data annotation workforce. Continuously analyze our Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows to identify and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Develop AI\-Powered "Co\-Pilots" and Accelerators: Architect, build, and deploy a portfolio of internal tools and intelligent agents that augment our human annotators. This includes automated quality checks, predictive assistance, and workflow\-agnostic automation scripts.
* Engineer "Safety Nets": Design and implement automated quality assurance (QA) systems and predictive monitoring to ensure we consistently exceed client SLAs for accuracy and throughput.
* Champion Human\-in\-the\-Loop Optimization: Leverage Generative AI, LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), and computer vision models to create systems that make our human workforce smarter, faster, and more accurate.
* Quantify Business Impact: Develop and maintain a framework to measure the ROI of your transformation initiatives, clearly demonstrating their impact on project margins, delivery speed, and client TCO.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Experience: 14\+ years in a technology field, with at least 5 years in a senior, client\-facing technical role such as a Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services Consultant, or Transformation Lead.
* Applied AI \& Process Automation: Proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-grade AI/ML systems specifically for process automation and optimization. This is more important than pure research experience.
* Generative AI Stack Expertise: Deep, practical experience with the modern Generative AI stack, including LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), agentic frameworks, and vector databases. You must have built things with these technologies.
* Hybrid Skillset: A demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of deep technology and business strategy. You must be able to write code and architect systems, but also create a compelling business case and present to a client executive.
* Cloud Architecture: Deep architectural expertise in one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including their managed AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Consultative Mindset: A natural ability to listen, diagnose problems, and guide clients and internal teams toward elegant, effective solutions.
* Data Annotation Domain Knowledge: Direct experience with data annotation platforms, data quality challenges, and the operational dynamics of large\-scale data labeling workforces.
* Experience Building Internal Tools: A track record of identifying an internal business need and building a software solution to address it, driving measurable efficiency gains.
* An advanced degree (master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is a strong plus.
* A portfolio of projects (e.g., GitHub) or detailed case studies demonstrating your work in building AI\-driven solutions.

* Build AI\-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.

* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.

* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI\-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.

* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**

* Expertise in XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.

* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network \& infrastructure security practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.

title: GTM Architect

title: Innovation Manager
description:
**Job Description** 




 We invite you to join the ZEISS Innovation Hub Chennai to shape together with us the future of advanced frugal innovation. We are turning today’s research into tomorrow’s applications – together with academic partners, students and entrepreneurs. Located at the IIT Madras Research Park, you will work in direct neighborhood to a world\-leading universities and with many startups co\-located in this dynamic environment. You will:
 



 • Drive new topics under the umbrella of advanced frugal innovation, by identifying and evaluating opportunities in the innovation sweet spot of desirability, feasibility, and viability
 



 • Find and work with partners in these topics in close cooperation with ZEISS stakeholders
 



 • Conduct innovation and market studies, identify customer needs, and develop solution concepts as part of an interdisciplinary team
 



 • Initiate and steer projects (incl. external partners) in the development of novel solutions (e.g., proof\-of\-concept demonstrators) and ensure the transfer of relevant knowhow to ZEISS
 



 • Support the successful transfer of concepts, technologies, and solutions to ZEISS business units
 



 • Screen and evaluate startups with strategic relevance for the Inno Hub's topics
 



 • Develop new business and venturing proposals and ideally lead your topic through incubation with our internal venture unit
 



  





 ZEISS employees work in a place where expert knowledge and team spirit reign supreme. All of this is supported by a special ownership structure and the long\-term goal of the Carl Zeiss Foundation: to bring science and society into the future together.
 



  





**Job Requirements** 



1. Ideally looking for 8\-12 years of relevant experience, can extend to 17 years.
2. A university degree in Mechanical engineering, physics, material sciences, or other relevant STEM fields, ideally with a PhD/M. Tech
3. Good knowledge in Solid works/CAM/CAD.
4. Profound knowledge in mechanics (elasticity and plasticity), materials science, finite element modeling, manufacturing (additive and subtractive), and other relevant fields
5. Ideally experience in innovation management or (internal) venturing, relevant methodologies such as design thinking, business models, lean startup, and software’s such as Miro, Power BI, Sharp cloud etc. for visualizing idea funnels
6. An intrapreneurial mindset, a holistic view of innovation and a desire to take topics beyond technology to market success
7. Experience in project management
8. A “together we go far” (collaboration) and “just do it” (action\-bias) mindset
9. Passion for innovation and enthusiasm for new technologies as well as fun working in agile, interdisciplinary, and cross\-border teams
10. Ability to persevere in the process of idea creation and rejection, with a positive mindset

title: Director/ Associate Director - Management Consulting
description:
**A. About Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd** 




 Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd. (Mercados) is a specialist consultancy firm, exclusively focused on business solutions in the energy and environment domain. Having begun our operations in India in 2008 supporting clients across the energy sector, we strive to promote efficient and sustainable energy markets; design effective regulations and assist energy businesses to succeed. Our approach integrates innovative, state\-of\-the\-art techniques with practical, tailor\-made solutions to solve current energy sector challenges. We have permanent offices in New Delhi (head office), Gurgaon, Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Pune and Lucknow. Mercados has presence across the Energy Value Chain and serves Clients both in the public and private domain. Mercados operates under two broad verticals, namely ‘Management Consulting’ and ‘Enterprise SaaS’. Our Consulting portfolio envelopes diverse segments like ‘Strategy and Business Growth’, ‘Policy, Economic Analysis and Regulations’, ‘Planning, Energy Markets \& Simulation Models’, ‘Transaction Advisory Services’, ‘Integrated Energy Supply Services’ and ‘Performance Improvement (Utility Management Services)’.
 



  





**B. About the Role:** 




 The Director / Associate Director – Management Consulting will be responsible for driving business growth and leading consulting engagements across Power Markets, Regulatory \& Policy, Distribution Operations, and commercial matters related to Generation, Distribution, Transmission \& Renewables Space. The role involves Business Development, selling Mercados' existing portfolio of solutions to new and existing clients, client leadership, team management, and quality assurance across projects, including bid process management for power procurement, evaluation of new initiatives, internal feasibility assessments, and preparation of concept notes and thought leadership papers. The AD/D is also expected to lead the development of high\-quality presentations for senior client leadership, conferences, webinars, and seminars.
 



  





**C. Detailed expectations from the role:** 



* The Director / Associate Director will report to senior leadership and will have end\-to\-end ownership of business growth, client relationships, and project delivery, with a key focus on managing and expanding Mercados' presence in the Southern region market. Key expectations include:
* Drive business development in the Southern region, identifying new opportunities and building a strong pipeline of consulting mandates.
* Lead efforts to sell Mercados' existing portfolio of solutions and services to new and existing clients across the region.
* Lead and manage multiple ongoing and future consulting assignments in the power and renewable energy sector, ensuring timely delivery of high\-quality outputs.
* Provide strategic advisory on energy policies, regulations, incentives, and reforms related to power generation, power procurement, and renewable energy.
* Oversee bid process management assignments for procurement of power by distribution licensees.
* Lead analysis of policy and regulatory developments and assess their implications on client businesses, providing actionable recommendations.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients in the Southern region, leading discussions, meetings, and stakeholder engagements.
* Mentor and guide team members, review their work, and ensure consistency, accuracy, and quality in deliverables.
* Coordinate closely with internal teams to manage project execution, resolve issues, and maintain delivery schedules.
* Lead preparation and presentation of concept notes, thought leadership papers, and client presentations for senior management forums.
* Represent the organization in client meetings, conferences, workshops, and industry events across the Southern region, as required.
* Foster a collaborative, high\-ownership team culture aligned with organizational goals.



  





**D. Required skill set:** 



* Proven track record in business development, client acquisition, and revenue growth within a consulting or advisory environment, ideally within the Southern region market.
* Demonstrated ability to sell a portfolio of consulting solutions to new and existing clients, and to build long\-term senior client relationships.
* Proven ability to lead multiple consulting engagements and manage complex assignments in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Strong understanding of the power sector value chain, with experience in at least two of the following areas — Power Markets, Power Distribution or Renewables— and the ability to translate this expertise into new business opportunities for the firm.
* Demonstrated experience working with a wide range of stakeholders, including Private, State, and Central Generators, Electricity Regulatory Commissions, Government bodies, and Power Utilities.
* Good understanding of the power sector landscape, including emerging policies and regulations, and their implications for clients.
* Excellent leadership, mentoring, and team management capabilities, with experience managing and growing consulting teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts and thought leadership clearly to senior stakeholders.
* High level of analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making ability.
* Proven ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in data analysis, reporting, and presentation tools (PowerPoint, Excel, etc.).
* Strong research orientation with the ability to translate insights into compelling client\-facing and thought leadership content.



  





**E. Education and Experience** 



* B.E/B. Tech or Equivalent with MBA in relevant field.
* Minimum 15 years of experience in at\-least two of the following areas\- Power Markets, Power Distribution and Renewable.
* Preference will be given to candidates having current working experience in Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and/or other Southern States.
* Energy/Power consultancy experience will be preferred.



  





**F. Location** 



* Base location shall be Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
* Open to travel for project execution and management



  





**G. Remuneration Structure** 



* We offer a motivation based and competitive reward package.

You will work closely with Sales/BD, Functional SCM, and senior architecture reviewers to turn incoming requests into credible technical responses, then carry validated solutions through pilot delivery.  Presales

 Solutions Architecture

* Contribute to the SC AI play portfolio, keeping architecture reusable across clients


**Qualifications, Experience And Aptitude \-**

* Hands\-on experience with both AI/agentic solutions and traditional integration/data builds
* Strength in one SC functional area (Planning/Forecasting, WMS, Order Management, Control Tower) plus working knowledge across the broader SC landscape
* Working knowledge preferred across any of: Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Manhattan, 09 (or similar)
* Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing exposure preferred

description:
As a Business Acquisition Executive, you will serve as the first point of contact for prospective and existing Mutual Fund Distributors (MFDs) entering the AssetPlus ecosystem.
   

  

 This is primarily a calling and business acquisition role focused on lead qualification, opportunity conversion, and pipeline movement. You will engage with marketing\-qualified leads (MQLs), understand their profile and intent, and convert them into sales\-qualified leads (SQLs) for onboarding and empanelment.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Be Split Across Two Core Areas**
* Enrolment of Prospective MFDs into AssetPlus Academy


**About**
 You will connect with aspiring MFDs who are interested in exploring mutual fund distribution as a career opportunity. Your role will involve educating them about:
   

  

* The mutual fund distribution industry
* The benefits of becoming an MFD
* AssetPlus Academy’s training program
* The process of certification and onboarding


 You will conduct business opportunity presentations, platform demos, and qualification conversations to encourage candidates to enroll in the training program.
   

  

* Empanelment of Existing ARN Holders


 You will also engage with existing Mutual Fund Distributors and introduce them to the AssetPlus platform, helping them understand the value proposition and guiding them toward empanelment with AssetPlus.
   

  

 As the first level of interaction in the funnel, you will play a critical role in ensuring high\-quality lead qualification, timely follow\-ups, and smooth handoff to the onboarding team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Lead Calling \& Qualification**
* Engage with marketing\-qualified leads (MQLs) through outbound calling and follow\-ups
* Qualify leads based on intent, profile fit, and readiness to proceed
* Convert qualified leads into SQLs for onboarding and training


**Business Opportunity Presentation \& Platform Demo**
* Conduct 1\-on\-1 business opportunity presentations and demos
* Educate prospects about:
* Mutual fund distribution as a career/business opportunity
* AssetPlus platform features and benefits
* Earning potential and growth opportunities
* Tailor conversations based on the prospect’s background


**Funnel Movement \& Follow\-Ups**
* Ensure timely engagement of all assigned leads within defined TATs
* Conduct structured follow\-ups to move leads through the funnel
* Maintain high responsiveness for priority leads


**CRM \& Operational Discipline**
* Maintain accurate lead records and follow\-up notes in CRM
* Update CRM within defined timelines after every interaction
* Keep activity trackers and reports updated on a daily/weekly/monthly basis


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 0–2 years of experience in telesales, business development, client acquisition, customer engagement, or tele\-calling roles
* Strong communication and persuasion skills
* Comfortable handling high\-volume calling and follow\-ups
* Ability to conduct consultative conversations and demos confidently
* Experience in BFSI or financial services is a plus
* Familiarity with CRM tools and lead management processes is preferred
* Fluent communication in Hindi and English (additional regional languages are a plus)
* Proactive, adaptable, persistent, and target\-oriented mindset


**What Success Looks Like**
* Consistently achieving SQL conversion and empanelment targets
* Driving strong funnel movement through timely follow\-ups
* Delivering high\-quality lead qualification
* Conducting impactful business opportunity presentations and demos
* Ensuring smooth handoff of qualified candidates to onboarding teams
* Maintaining strong CRM hygiene and operational discipline
* Contributing actionable feedback to improve lead quality and campaign performance
